steps.text: Single drops of sound. Rings leave the centre like a launch countdown.
Pulse quickens; concentric rings stack into an orbit map.
Whole-dish drive: the first standing squares lock in.
Breathe with the swell - 6 breaths a minute.
Leaving orbit.
Two tones in 2:3 - the water prefers hexagons.
A hexagonal jet stream, like the one Cassini filmed at Saturn's pole.
Storm bands tighten.
Octave pair: triangles appear inside the hexagons.
4:5 forcing - the 12-fold quasipattern Edwards & Fauve found in 1993. Order without repetition.
6:7 - superlattices: hexagons nested in hexagons.
The nebula drifts; phase slips make the pattern rotate.
Single tone again: back to squares, the ground state of water.
Return to twelve-fold.
A spinning neutron star: one ring per beat.
Two beats a second - rings collide with their echoes off the wall.
Faster - interference lace.
Spin down.
Earth and Venus line up five times in eight years, tracing a five-petalled rose. Use the pentagon insert.
Faraday drive inside a pentagon: the wall shape bends the squares into five-fold arcs.
Slow swell.
High drive: fine squares, tiles shrinking to the edge like an Escher circle.
Slow beating between tones makes the lattice breathe in and out.
Finer still.
Fold into twelve.
Breathe in as the swell rises, out as it falls (6 per minute).
Squares under the Flower of Life.
Hexagons under an eight-point star.
Slower: 5 breaths a minute.
Stillness. Let the last ring reach the wall.
Frequencies fall by the golden ratio: 89...
21, pulsing at 0.618 Hz...
13. Fibonacci all the way down.
Low and wide.
Second tone enters.
Density rises.
Thirty-fold E8 shadow on the gobo.
Peak: finest lattice the water can hold.
Release.
Long slow waves - ribbons of green light.
Ribbons fold.
A pink curtain appears.
Fade to night.
Squares - the simplest standing wave.
Rings.
Splashdown.

steps.text: Genesis: Orbit Rings. A single point taps the water once a second; each ring travels out through printed orbit circles.
Flower of Life Bloom. Rings bloom through 19 interlaced circles at a breathing pace.
Apollonian Pearls. Circles within circles; a ring foot sends waves inward to focus at the centre.
Sunflower Spiral. Golden-angle seeds pulsed at 0.618 per second.
Fibonacci Gold. The golden spiral in a golden-rectangle dish, pulsed at 1/phi.
Metatron. Metatron's lines bend over a hexagonal standing wave, breathing slowly.
Guest from Fractal Forest: Koch Snowfall.
Bridge: the light turns toward Solar Winds.
Solar Winds: Fresnel Sun. A zone plate focuses light into bright rings while ripples pulse through them.
Galaxy Arms. Logarithmic arms with soft rings rolling outward.
Twin Source. Young's two-source fringes made by two pins on one foot.
Lissajous Weave. The 3:4 figure is the picture of the two tones being played.
Star of Twelve. A twelve-point star over twelve-fold water.
Dragon Fold. The paper-folding dragon over square Faraday waves.
Guest from Hyperbolic Deep: Hyperbolic Abyss.
Bridge: the light turns toward Saturn Rising.
Saturn Rising: Saturn Storm. Two tones at 2:3 make the water choose hexagons; the hexagon wall and gobo lock them in place.
